text: It works, but when I went to the doctor's office today, it didn't because I had not opened up settings to record in the background. So it glitched at the end of the recording. When I turned on the background setting, it then deleted my doctor's appointment recording. i was lucky enough to remmeber the most important details and recorded them myself. but I was hoping to have it done and not do it again.
author: Emma Blakey (Home)
developer_reply: Hi Emma, thanks for the feedback, and apologies about the inconvenience. Without background permission, Android kills backgrounded apps (an OS-level behaviour we can't override). That said, if the recording finished before the app closed, it is likely recoverable. Please email info@recallify.ai with your details and we will investigate.

author: Angle BG
developer_reply: Hello, sorry you had a bad experience. If there is something specific that wasn't working for you, we would like to know so we can fix it. You can reach us at info@recallify.ai.

text: Requires an immediate subscription. how can I even know if your app is any good if I can't try it for free for a little then buy a sub? no I will not do a 7 day free trial. I don't trust you yet, why should I trust you with my money. edit: even if Google Play handles the subscription it's still not the best practice. I understand you want to make money off the app but I have no idea how the app functions without first trying it.
author: L C
developer_reply: Hi L C, I am sorry to hear this. Just to clarify, Recallify offers a 7-day free trial with NO charge, so you can definitely try it for free for 7 days with full access to all features. Card details are handled by Google Play, not Recallify, so we never see your payment information. Happy to answer any questions at info@recallify.ai.

author: Yuminilly Syrie
developer_reply: Hi Yuminilly, sorry to hear that. Recallify offers a 7-day free trial, so you won't be charged during that period. A card is needed to start, but you can cancel anytime within the 7 days. If you're living with a neurological condition and don't have a bank card, please email info@recallify.ai as we do arrange free voucher codes for access.
